title: Betrayal at Falador
author: T.S. Church
quote: "I will fight with you." Lord Radebaugh said, and his voice reverberated with growing conviction. A stunned silence descended over the soldiers. Somewhere nearby a horse neighed. Suddenly there rose a cheer from every man present. "I shall fight with you!" a man pledged, stepping forward. "As shall I!" another declared, drawing his sword and holding it high. And then, six hundred swords were raised in unison and again the men cheered. Theodore held out his hand and Lord Radebaugh took it in a tight grasp.

RuneScape: Shadows of Amascut
author: Erin M. Evans
notes: O Amascut of the Ten Thousand Blades, the Unflinching, Eye of the Sun! Tear the unworthy from this life and deliver us from their predations.
name: Titles1

title: RuneScape: Shadows of Amascut
author: Erin M. Evans
notes: Then comes the Devourer, Great of Death. Culler of the Unworthy from the Heavens to the Underworld to the Lands Beyond the Reach of the Sun. Bow ye gods, or be unmade
name: Titles2

title: RuneScape: Shadows of Amascut
author: Erin M. Evans
notes: O Icthlarin of the Ten Thousand Paths, the Unceasing, Voice of the Sun! Lead us to the fortress of your strength, the springs of your mother's bounty that our enemies might not plague us!
name: Titles1

title: RuneScape: Shadows of Amascut
author: Erin M. Evans
notes: Ages ago, when the threat of Zaros first arose, Icthlarin, Opener of the Ways, had gone with his fierce sister to the world beyond the Sun, beyond the Sky.

title: RuneScape: Shadows of Amascut
author: Erin M. Evans
notes: "They seek the souls of Tumeken." The High Priest of Icthlarin had a face like a scythe, long and sharp. Dark and lined with the sun, he spoke every whispered word like a pronouncement from the Guardian of Souls. "Their foul Imperator-God wishes to steal the sun's essence."

title: RuneScape: Shadows of Amascut
author: Erin M. Evans
notes: This man wears the head of a jackal, the ears high and pointed, the fur black and sleek. His voice is a man's and his words are poetry. Icthlarin of the Ten-Thousand Paths, the Unceasing, Voice of the Sun. Herdsman of the Dead, Guardian of the Souls.

title: RuneScape: Shadows of Amascut
author: Erin M. Evans
notes: Scabaras, Silence of the South, Breath of the Desert. A beetle with a human body. A true prayer to the lonely god was quiet and stillness, and so Satia offered this, trying to make her thoughts small, burrowing them beneath the sound of her breath. The beetle god was entirely His own nature.
name: Titles1

title: RuneScape: Shadows of Amascut
author: Erin M. Evans
notes: "Het, Stone of the North, Fist of the Desert, who holds open the way, who lifts up the burdened. My will is yours, my blade is yours, tell me what you command?"
name: Titles1

title: RuneScape: Shadows of Amascut
author: Erin M. Evans
notes: "Crondis, Oasis of the East, Teeth of the Desert, who bides and abides, who sustains us and steadies us. My will is yours, my blade is yours, tell me what you command?"
name: Titles1
